1) GRU-FCNs can outperform LSTM-FCNs for time series classification, 2) GRU-fully connected networks (GRU-FNs) can be used as an alternative to GRU-FCNS, 3) the GRU-FCNNs can be extended to multivariate time series, 4) GRU-Convolutional Neural Networks (GRU-CNNs) can be used for time series classification.

a GRU-based hybrid model can offer a better classification performance compared to the LSTMbased hybrid model on univariate time-series datasets.
